dataset: City of Toronto Forest and Land Cover — 2018 study

grid.sampling: Polygon pixel centres, all_touched=false; class bitset unions same-class overlap; conflicting classes are code 9, unknown/outside code 0. Municipal centre mask. No interpolation of class labels.

license_evidence: Official catalogue page and current CKAN license_id identify OGL–Toronto.
limits: Historical 2018 top-down classification, not current vegetation or ground truth; canopy can obscure roads.
16 m display samples lose narrow features; transparent unknown/conflict cells are not bare ground.
Draped onto independently sourced coarse 2023 CGVD2013 terrain for context; source vintages differ. No physical ground, access, traffic or hydrological inference.
Available across municipality near camera only; overview retains elevation colours.
source_crs: EPSG:2952, verified OpenFileGDB layer metadata, not the older 2008 NAD27 source
